svg.title: AIcoach secondary pages

text.tspan: Your swing clips and results are private to your
account. You can delete them at any time.
This email already has an account. Sign in instead, or
use another email.

g.text: Shown on its own page; both forms drawn here.
Eight steps for a clip AIcoach can read.
Behind you, along the target line.
On or parallel to the hands line.
Tripod or propped on your bag.
Slow motion setting, if you have it.
In frame for the full swing.
Step 5 highlighted: opened from a rejection reason.

text.tspan: This swing clip cannot support a result, so AIcoach
has not guessed one. Fix these and film again.

g.text: Your frame: feet cut off at the bottom edge
Film from behind you, along the target line.
Move back until your whole body and club fit.
Too few frames around impact. Use 120 fps or higher.
No confidence band: nothing was measured.

text.tspan: None of the three faults AIcoach checks was found in
this swing.
Weight appears to move
toward the trail side
at the top.
This is outside the rule table. Unverified, confirm with
a coach. No drill or exercise is given for it.

g.text: You can still ask the coach about this result.
6 saved swing clips. Only you can see them.
Open two swings to see them side by side.

text.tspan: Removes its result and key frames, and the swing clip if
it was saved. Use Delete in the swing library or on the
result.
Removes all your analyses, results, key frames and saved
swing clips. You will not be able to sign in again. This
cannot be undone.

svg.text: Ask the coach: staying inside the analysis

g.text: Answers are based only on this analysis.

text.tspan: Should I change my grip as well?
This analysis does not measure your grip, so I cannot tell
you whether to change it. It only covers what the video
showed: your hips moved toward the ball by 7% of your body
height. For grip, ask a coach who can see you swing.
Can I skip the 90/90 exercise if my
hip hurts?
Yes, stop if it hurts. The 90/90 is generic guidance, not
medical advice, and AIcoach cannot assess pain. See a
physiotherapist before you carry on. The wall drill does
not load the hip the same way.

g.text: Showing A on Plate 2: lead hip
When a question is outside the analysis, the coach says so.

text.tspan: Hips partly hidden
in the impact
frame.
Your hips were only partly visible at impact, and the
clip is 60 fps, so high confidence was not possible. The
result stands, but film again to confirm it.
Keep your bag and trolley out of the line between the
phone and your hips. Use 120 fps.
